title: Invalid State Admissions Benchmark: admission cases and disposition scorer
description: A benchmark for what stateful AI systems write into shared state. Version 2.1.0 is a scorer-correctness release of 2.0.0: persisted records are compared as whole records (no unsupported field, confirmation, audience, link, validity or target passes); extra fields in served answers must be supported by the state the read resolves to; records must carry the step, submitting account and recording time of the step that submitted them; and the runner exports state after every step and every read, so an invalid admission that is later deleted or overwritten, or a read that changes state, is caught (adapter contract isa-adapter/2.1, output schema isa-run-output/2.1; 2.0 output files are still accepted). Ground truth states validity and attribution where 2.0.0 left them open. Baseline numbers are unchanged. Contents as in 2.0.0: 39 synthetic cases in 12 families with system-visible inputs separated from ground truth, declared rules and target contracts, a Level 1 disposition scorer and a Level 2 stateful runner, and the metrics OAR, IPAR, VSAR, CDR, SRA, UFR, DLR and CPR with critical failures and exact intervals. Measured baselines: always-reject, always-hold, always-admit and a non-LLM reference rules baseline written with knowledge of the public cases (an illustration, not evidence of generality; a probe set shows its brittleness). Language-model baselines are a runnable harness and have not been run. No result is reported for any AI system. The v1.0.0 cases and scorer are kept unchanged under v1/. Code: MIT.
